security_spec.violation_condition: When Zfinx is implemented in XiangShan RTL but the mstateen0/sstateen0/hstateen0 CSR chain is not fully wired into the instruction decoder's floating-point legality check, or when these stateen CSRs are hardwired (e.g., mstateen0.FCSR tied to 1), the spec-mandated check_f_ok function would skip the legacy mstatus.FS gate without enforcing the replacement stateen-based gate, allowing floating-point instructions to execute in privilege contexts where they should trap with IllegalInstruction.
security_spec.summary: Zfinx path replaces mstatus.FS check with stateen CSR chain (mstateen0/sstateen0/hstateen0.FCSR); if stateen CSRs are not fully implemented or wired into the decode stage, FP instructions execute without any privilege gate, bypassing both the old mstatus.FS and the new stateen checks
